title: Why Is Source Credibility Important for High School Research? — High School Toolkit
skills: explain why source credibility matters in academic research
evaluate how unreliable sources can weaken claims and conclusions
select trustworthy evidence for research projects
apply credibility standards when gathering and using information
alignment_note: Explains why source credibility is essential in high school research and how trustworthy evidence strengthens accuracy, reasoning, and academic integrity. Supports information literacy, research planning, source evaluation, and evidence-based writing across high school English courses.
